turns.content: Now I see the issue. The error message says "Network disruption: HTTP mutating methods blocked at kernel level" and it's coming from `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/sitecustomize.py:6`. This is a custom sitecustomize file that's blocking POST, DELETE, PUT, and PATCH requests.

This is the culprit! The `sitecustomize.py` file is monkey-patching `requests.Session.request` to block all HTTP mutating methods (POST, DELETE, PUT, PATCH). This explains why tests that only read data (GET requests) work fine, but tests that modify data (POST, DELETE, PUT, PATCH) fail.
